demo.title: hoodgrow-x402.sh
demo.code:
# HoodGrow: pay-per-call Robinhood Chain stock token data over x402 (USDC on Base). No signup, no API key.
# 1) Call an endpoint - you get HTTP 402 with payment terms in the `payment-required` header
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/tokens"          # full catalog - $0.50
curl -s -D - "https://www.hoodgrow.com/api/agent/token/NVDA"      # one symbol - $0.05

# 2) Pay the advertised USDC amount on Base with your x402-capable agent/wallet,
#    then retry the same URL with the payment proof to receive JSON:
#    price, corporate-action adjusted supply, Morpho/Uniswap DeFi depth, and
#    pending/historical corporate actions.

# Human-readable docs: https://www.hoodgrow.com/api-access

setup: No signup or API key. You need an x402-capable agent or wallet funded with USDC on Base.
On HTTP 402, pay the advertised USDC amount on Base and retry to receive structured JSON.
Or skip raw HTTP: `npm i hoodgrow` / `pip install hoodgrow` for a typed client that handles x402 payment for you, or `npx hoodgrow-mcp` for an MCP server if your agent is an MCP client.
